name: Yuukan Shinshi
source:
Company president is blessed with status and health, but he life looses its colors for him. The only thing he can enjoy is to train his recently remarried wife and daughter-in-law. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-january-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一位公司总裁拥有地位和健康，但生活对他失去了色彩。他唯一能享受的事情就是调教他刚再婚的妻子和儿媳。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-january-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
